page.overview:
What is Caesar Bilzen's house?

Caesar Bilzen's house is a three-story building just south of Hierarch Square in Novigrad and belongs to Caesar Bilzen, the accountant of Carlo Varese, one of the Big Four of the city. Together with his endless fishing trophies, the dwarf used to collect a great amount of Nilfgaardian memorabilia.
